## Verdict

One paragraph: what the site's authority position is, the two or three
moves that will change it, and the first thing to do on Monday.

## Where we start

Facts only, each with a source (audit row, GSC, Ahrefs, memory):

| Fact | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Referring domains | | Ahrefs WT / GSC Links |
| Branded vs non-branded clicks | | GSC |
| Blog posts, newest, cadence | | audit `feed` |
| Discover-ready posts | | audit `newsroom` |

## Move 1 — preserve what is already earned

Legacy URL list, redirects fixed, unlinked mentions found and asked.

## Move 2 — claim what is already ours

The relationship inventory: investors, incubators, institutions on the
"recognised by" band, customers/partners, registries, databases, entity
anchors, events, founders' footprints. Each with a named contact and an ask.

## Move 3 — linkable assets (pick 2–3)

| Asset | Data we already have | Owner | Ship by |
|---|---|---|---|

## Move 4 — newsroom

Tracks, authors and their pages, technical requirements met (list what the
gate needs and who fixes each), the first twelve pieces with hook and target
outlet, cadence, sign-off rule.

## Move 5 — earn with expertise

Journalist platforms (who has profiles), academic reciprocity list,
open-source contributions, trade press pitch order, events this year.

## Move 6 — LinkedIn, community, video

Canonical-first rules, newsletter name and cadence, company-page rhythm,
communities and the person who participates, video plan.

## Move 7 — AI-citation track

Bing verified, crawlers fixed, `llms.txt`, answer-first pages, entity
consistency, the ten target prompts and today's score.

## Measurement

Monthly: referring domains, links live from the tracker, non-branded clicks,
Discover impressions, AI-citation share on the ten prompts, feed cadence.
Targets for day 90.

## What we will not do

Bought links, "Google News approved" guest posts, press-release wires for
links, PBNs, reciprocal rings, syndicating full text before the original is
indexed, placeholder authors, anything the vertical file marks off-limits.

## Sources

Links to the policy pages and reports the plan relies on.
